purpose: Derive the seventh C2 long-tail promotion queue into source-specific deep-read tasks so each cancer-control, survivorship, transplant-safety, organ-donation or bioengineered organ-replacement domain-source pair can later be checked for exact claim use, endpoints, population/setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position before any reviewed artifact or model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B7 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed local review or independent fresh review.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain claim seed.
Candidate URLs require source-context reading and may still need manual access if a publisher page, fulltext, guideline PDF, cancer-control standard, registry page or archive blocks automated checks.
No task may be promoted into reviewed Source Cards, variables, endpoints, downgrade checks or calibrated models until exact source-context fields and fresh review are complete.

queueDefaults.minimumExtractionQuestion: For this C2-LT-B7 domain-source pair, what exact claim, endpoint, population/setting, mechanism/effect signal, uncertainty, transfer boundary and downgrade trigger can this source support without overclaiming?
